d: Cabinet in the apartments of Ubaldo. Ubaldo sits at a table, surrounded by gloomy sadness: his noble Friends and the Family of his powerful house surround him.
Room of the palace of Sigifredo. ~ Side doors and verona in prospect that responds to the garden. Elena.
The followers of Ubaldo, then Gualtiero, then a band of Armigeri and sayings.
Room in the Town Hall. Boemondo and Ubaldo, seated.
Boemondo's apartments. A secret exit opens at the bottom, from which Guido is crossed, preceded by many men of arms, who move away by other way.
Magnificent room, pompously set up, to celebrate the conquest of Belluno. Dames and Knights of the court of Boemondo: Ubaldo is among them.
Boemondo leads Imberga, Guido follows them: the above ones. Upon the arrival of Boemondo everyone bows.
He opens a door, where Elena appears: the above ones.
Gallery adorned with portraits, in the palace of Sigifredo. Elena prostrated before the effigy of her mother.

Room of Elena: two side doors, and at the bottom large open verona from which I glimpsed the dome of the cathedral: it is night; a double burning on a table. Elena pale as death, and lying on a chair. Gualtiero is halfway out of her.
